title: selfdoc check skips dead references to a removed doc, and sections holding a parenthesis, backtick or colon
goal: dead_section_refs reports a bare (<name>.md, Section) reference whose kb/_self doc no longer exists when no other file of that name is in the repository, a section text holding ( ) ` : or ; or wrapping onto the next line, and a reference into kb/_self/ subdirectories such as kb/_self/reports/; each with a planted case (SP-ar52y6fk review of ST-mklj46kq)

run:
import sys,tempfile,pathlib as P;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import selfdoc as S;r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());(r/'kb/_self').mkdir(parents=True);(r/'kb/_self/a.md').write_text('# A
## Real
');(r/'AGENTS.md').write_text('See (gone.md, Real) and (a.md, Missing (note)) and (a.md, Gone: x).
');p=S.dead_section_refs(str(r),{'AGENTS.md','kb/_self/a.md'});assert len(p)==3,p
